hits.text: How a Bitcoin Transaction Works https://t.co/tTjvnyE1s1
hits.hook: How a Bitcoin Transaction Works https://t.co/tTjvnyE1s1
hits.draft_en:
How a $BTC transaction works, in 4 steps:
1. your wallet signs with your private key
2. the tx goes to the mempool
3. a miner includes it in a block
4. each new block adds a confirmation

Whoever holds the key decides who can sign.

Save this / repost to someone new to $BTC.
hits.draft_quote_en: The part people skip: step one only works if you hold the key. On an exchange, they sign, not you.

narrative_synthesis: Monday 20:00: exchange risk dominates. Mercado Bitcoin halted withdrawals after a reported $40M+ hack (1.2M views on WatcherGuru), Binance says 95% of hack losses are covered while $14.1B left it in a week (reported), and North Korea denies the attribution. Sentiment hit 'fear' for the first time since August; glassnode shows the longest net realized-loss streak since mid-August below $80k. Strategy added 811 BTC (849,327 total), ETFs ended the week net negative. Best reply angles: base rates (fear readings, midterms n=3, loss streaks), denominators ($3.3B vs $6.3B, ETF net), and custody (withdrawal freezes).
